component.name: Smart DND
component.summary: Automated Do Not Disturb based on schedules and calendar events

description.p: Smart DND automatically enables Do Not Disturb (DND) mode on a schedule or during matching calendar events.

ul.li: Automated schedule windows with midnight wrapping
Calendar event keyword and regex pattern matching
Buffer offsets to start DND early or extend after meetings
Pluggable architecture for calendar backends, notification systems, and frontends
Native Libadwaita interface with system tray integration
